title: Guided Generation of Linux Kernel Semantic Patches with Small Local Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a Linux kernel API changes, hundreds of drivers are converted by hand over months, and the earlier conversions are reviewed examples for the later ones. We ask whether small open language models running on a laptop can turn such examples into Coccinelle semantic patches, the rules kernel maintainers already use for tree-wide changes. We adapt guided code generation to this task: the training examples are decomposed by script into a tree of change variants, the model writes one small rule per variant under feedback from applying it to the examples, deterministic components repair SmPL syntax and generalise driver-specific names, rules are composed greedily, and a compile critic repairs or rejects a rule whose output does not build. We evaluate on a pre-registered test set of 7 migrations whose new APIs appeared after the training cutoffs of all three models (Qwen2.5-Coder 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, Gemma 3 4B), with 122 held-out driver conv

translated_title: 基于小型本地语言模型的Linux内核语义补丁引导生成
translated_abstract: 当Linux内核API发生变化时，数百个驱动程序需要在数月内手工完成转换，而较早完成的转换可以作为后续转换的审查范例。我们探讨在笔记本电脑上运行的小型开源语言模型能否将这类范例转化为Coccinelle语义补丁——即内核维护者已经用于全树范围修改的规则。我们针对该任务改进了引导式代码生成：通过脚本将训练示例分解为变更变体树，模型在将规则应用于示例所得反馈的指导下为每个变体编写一个小规则；确定性组件负责修复SmPL语法并泛化驱动程序特定的名称；规则以贪心方式组合；同时编译评审器会修复或拒绝输出无法通过编译的规则。我们在一个预先注册的测试集上进行评估，该测试集包含7个迁移任务，其新API的出现时间晚于全部三个模型（Qwen2.5-Coder 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma 3 4B）的训练截止日期，并包含122个留出的驱动程序转换……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种引导式生成方法，使笔记本电脑上运行的小型开源语言模型能够将少量人工转换的驱动程序范例自动转化为Coccinelle语义补丁，从而实现Linux内核API变更后的全树代码迁移自动化，且在新API超出模型训练数据的情况下依然有效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a guided generation approach that enables small local open language models to convert a few manually converted driver examples into Coccinelle semantic patches, automating tree-wide Linux kernel API migrations even for new APIs beyond the models' training cutoffs.
